_doc: Machine-readable asset budgets (TD-009 / T-PIPE-03). Read by Tools/uwp validator.

lod_triangle_fraction_max._doc: TD-012 (T-PIPE-05): max triangles of LOD<n> as a fraction of the category LOD0 budget (master prompt §5.5: characters 40k/20k/8k).

collision_budget._doc: TD-012 (T-PIPE-05): collision proxy budgets. Convex hulls are capped by the generator (convex_max_vertices); authored or trimesh proxies are checked here.

gate_profile._doc: uwp --profile gate = the release gate a PRODUCTION-READY asset must pass (QUALITY_GATE phase 7). Warnings become errors; these extra rules apply.

animation._doc: T-ANIM-01 / master prompt §6.3: max foot sliding per locomotion clip (from <asset>.anim_report.json, measured by the character builder). Warning in dev, error in --profile gate.
